fusions.name: Heel Grind
fusions.desc: A grinding blow that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Crushing Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Marching Hide
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Layered Stride
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
